snippet.title: HOW TO PLAY Magnetic Me VR (Beginner’s Guide + Tutorial)
snippet.description:
👾 Download Magnetic Me FREE on Meta Quest Store: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/magnetic-me/9577590078954461

New to Magnetic Me VR? ⚡ This video shows you the basics of the game: how to use your magnets, complete the tutorial, and explore the lobby. Perfect if you just downloaded the game or want to understand what it’s all about!

🔥 Developed by me & my brothers in just 3 months!

What’s inside this video:
– Welcome to Magnetic Me
– How magnets work
– Completing the tutorial
– Exploring the lobby
– Next steps & PvP
⚡ Try it out and tell us what you think in the comments!
